d961a5bca1:
The year-long war between the Zeon forces and the
Earth Federation Forces was nearing its climax
at the space fortress A Baoa Qu.
442bc6ae14:
Char, who had lost his Gelgoog in the preceding battle,
was given a new machine through Kycilia's arrangement.
96e09e7462:
Strike down the Gundam! For Char, who schemed
to overthrow the Zabi family, the Gundam was now
the very enemy he had to defeat.
a55d823bec: Isn't your real enemy the Zabi family!?
ef50d36b62:
For me... it's different!
Do you understand
why I lured you in here?
26cf077cd9:
Because I thought that even a Newtype
uses his body just like an ordinary person!
bb6bb881d6:
Skills of the body need training,
even for a Newtype!
0d1e681413:
I hear anti-Federation movements are active in the
Earth Sphere, but out here at distant Axis we cannot
learn the details. Will you scout Earth for us, Char?
3dde26d6e9:
It is Haman's request. I can hardly refuse.
In return, if I may,
I will take these two with me.
a5132e2b87:
Roberto and Apolly, was it?
Veteran mobile suit pilots of Zeon.
Be Char's hands and feet, and help him.
5934a69260:
I leave the rest to you, Haman.
Please take care of Lady Mineva.
16e8a7a218:
The fated duel between Char and Amuro ended
without a victor, with the fall of A Baoa Qu
and the destruction of the Zabi family.
789993fe69:
Escaping A Baoa Qu with the defeated Zeon troops, Char
fled to the Asteroid Belt, the field of asteroids that
stretches between Mars and Jupiter.
3bb7615454:
The Zeon remnants made the asteroid Axis their base,
raised Dozle Zabi's orphan Mineva as successor, and
plotted to restore the Zabis and return to Earth.
0e252d69f5:
Four years later, at Axis, were Haman Karn, leading in
place of the young Mineva, and Char, who had changed
his name to Quattro Bajeena.
bfb4d7a739:
Hiding in a dark, cold corner of space, the ghosts of
Zeon waited for their time to come...
An age of upheaval begins to stir once more.
